_comment: Second endpoint: Wan2.1 VACE-14B reference-to-video (character refs + text -> 5 s 720p). Image built with WAN_REPO=Wan2.1 (tag :vace). 80 GB class GPU: the bf16 DiT alone is ~34 GB, T5 11 GB, plus 720p x 81 f activations and the VAE decode. gpuTypeIds are a PRIORITY list applied by the REST PATCH in deploy.sh; verify the exact id strings against RunPod's GPU list before the first deploy (see CC-DISPATCH-phase4-vace). executionTimeoutSec 5400: a cold 50-step 720p job on an A100 can take 30+ min (2 forward passes per step, SDPA not flash-attn).
